static_traits.name: Wang Feina
static_traits.family_status: Living alone；父母已Retired，居住在外地
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友关系因压力而有所紧张、Reduced socializing；同时拥有支持性的朋友与同事，可在遇到困难时交流
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；过往not yet出现类似心理问题，not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, strong logic, high cooperation, positive attitude and willingness to try new methods

basic_info.main_problem: 因Work量大而感到overwhelmed与压力，影响到从事并享受个人爱好。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this stress significantly affects my mental health and overall enjoyment of life.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough，若达not到高标准就会被negate
Only by continuously being efficient and meeting all expectations am I valuable

special_situations.event: Workload has increased markedly, needing to handle multiple projects at once and face pressing deadlines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能同时高质量且按时完成所有任务，就说明我not胜任并会被批评
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overtime and self-pressure; sacrifices hobbies to devote to work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我根本完not成所有Work，也have not时间做爱好。

special_situations.event: At the start of a busy work week, the schedule is packed with meetings and tasks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not整块Freedom时间，就意味着without法兼顾Work与生活
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Gives up social and interest activities in advance to avoid 'losing control'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这周一定have not任何空闲，什么爱好都做not了。

special_situations.event: Completing a project and receiving overall positive feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要反馈里有改进意见，就说明整体表现并not佳
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复关注not足之处、忽视正面信息
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Even if there is praise, it shows I still have many problems.

special_situations.event: 自从六个月前Work量增加后对not yet来Work的Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果当前很忙，not yet来也会一直这样，生活很难Recovery平衡
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent worry, hard to relax; reduces attempts to engage in hobbies
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It will always be this busy from now on; I will hardly ever enjoy life well again.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to keep a sense of control over work and life
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被批评、被认为not胜任
defense_goal: Preventing failure and criticism by maintaining high standards and self-harshness

object_relations.self_representation: 努力但随时可能被negate的执行者

manifestations: Work occupies the rhythm of life, and subjectively time feels bound by work, making it hard to choose to invest time in hobbies and socializing
outcomes: Decreased sense of control over life

manifestations: Reduced ability to enjoy life and hobbies; fewer social activities

positive_force: The ability, in most cases, to complete tasks on time and receive positive feedback
愿意尝试新方法（认知重构、正念等）并具备自我Reflection
Has a support network of colleagues and friends to confide in
negative_force: A thinking style tending to predict the worst outcomes and overgeneralize
心理过滤导致忽视积极反馈、聚焦not足
Objective workload is high, handling multiple projects and urgent deadlines simultaneously
Sensitivity to criticism and dependence on external evaluation of self-worth

target_behavior.behavior: 与Work相关的Persistent anxiety与压力反应（紧张、担忧、Difficulty relaxing）
antecedent: When a busy work week begins
When handling multiple projects with tight deadlines simultaneously
When seeing the schedule packed with meetings and tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心without法满足高标准并被批评，将个do not压力情境泛化为持续性的威胁
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与被negate的潜在风险，促使Over-preparation与自我施压以寻求安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced work focus、效率受影响；爱好与社交被削减，Reduced life satisfaction

target_behavior.behavior: 回避（Reduced socializing与兴趣活动的投入）
antecedent: 在认为have not整块Freedom时间时
target_behavior.core_reason: 相信若not牺牲休闲就会失控或达not到标准，将放松视为风险
target_behavior.function: 短期降低Anxiety与Sense of guilt，保留更多时间以应对Work
target_behavior.consequence: 长期愉悦感与Recovery力下降，社交Relationship tension，进一步加重压力体验
